academy.title: Fund scholarships for youth
academy.desc: Your donation goes to the Academy's general scholarship fund. The organization distributes resources based on the needs of each student and course.
academy.noticeText: Your donation is directed to the Academy in general. The courses below are for informational purposes only: the board of Valores Sinaí  assigns scholarships based on current criteria and needs.

solidarity.title: Support the community directly
solidarity.desc: The Solidarity Fund finances campus maintenance, infrastructure improvements, and community events, camps, and retreats. The organization decides distribution based on the most urgent needs.

events.title: Community events and retreats
events.desc: We fund camps, spiritual retreats, cultural gatherings, and activities that unite our community.

maintenance.title: Campus maintenance
maintenance.desc: We care for and improve our sports facilities, halls, green spaces, and daily equipment.

infrastructure.title: Improvement works
infrastructure.desc: We expand and renovate the property to keep welcoming more people and they feel comfortably and safely.

solidarity.quote: "Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others." — 1 Peter 4:10

impact.scholarship: you cover a student's materials for one month.

form.coverFeeDesc: MercadoPago deducts a fee from each payment. By enabling this option, you add an extra amount so that 100% of your donation reaches Valores Sinaí.
form.arRateNote: Rates verified for Argentina (2026). May vary slightly depending on your bank or card.
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us why you decided to donate...
form.messageHint: Your message may be included in the donation report.
form.amountReminderTitle: Remember to enter this amount in MercadoPago
form.amountReminderDesc: Includes the fee so that {{donation}} reaches Valores Sinaí.
form.step1: 1. Click the "Donate with Mercado Pago" button and we'll open Mercado Pago in another tab.
form.step3: 3. Complete the payment with your preferred method.
form.step4: 4. Done! You'll receive a receipt by email.
form.mpOpenedDesc: Complete the payment in the window that just opened.
form.securityNote: You'll be redirected to MercadoPago. You enter the amount there securely.
form.mpArgentinaOnly: MercadoPago is available for donors in Argentina only.
form.mpExternalAlt: Donating from outside Argentina? You can wire transfer in USD to our Supervielle account.

payment.label: Payment method
payment.mpNote: Accepts Argentine cards, Pix (Brazil), and more LATAM payment methods. Fee: ~6.6% + VAT (payment link).
payment.paypalNote: Ideal for donors from the USA, Europe, and around the world. Fee: ~3.9% + USD 0.30 per transaction.
payment.bankNote: No fees. 100% of your donation reaches Valores Sinaí. See instructions below.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.desc: If you prefer to transfer directly, 100% of your donation reaches Valores Sinaí with no platform fees. Send us the receipt by email or WhatsApp to register your contribution.
bank.afterTransferText: Send the receipt to valoressinai@gmail.com or via WhatsApp at +54 9 11 6012-2363 with your name and destination (Academy / Solidarity Fund). Your donation will be registered and we'll send you a confirmation.
bank.usdHint: For international donors. Transfer in USD from any country.
bank.usdOnlyExternal: The USD account is the only available option for donors outside Argentina.

panel.sendReceiptTitle: Your message will be sent with the receipt
